_note: SpeedKills' city (src/game/city.ts, docs/PHASE_18_PLAN_SPEEDKILLS.md 7.9): a 500 m square at night, map-local metres round its middle (the world's BR_X, BR_Z). seed builds the same city on every browser. The owner's layout: nine sectors, the centre the biggest (200 m) and the hottest drop. Ours otherwise.
_sectors: The nine sectors, map-local (z grows south, as the maps are laid out): the centre, THE SPIRE, 200 m across; the eight round it each a district with its own neon accent, so where you are reads by colour from anywhere. The decay takes them away in waves (J), the centre most often last.
_blocks: The blocks along one axis, map-local metres; the 14 m between two is a street (six streets each way, 49 blocks). The centre sector's edges fall on block edges at 100, so a street never straddles two sectors.
_build: storey is floor to floor (4 m, the owner's storey, which movement.speedkills.json's double jump and climb are measured against); kerb is the pavement's height over the street (a step, under the 0.56 m a body steps up). heights are storeys, least and most, by how far a block is from the centre: the core's two rings of blocks, the middle ring, the edge. megatower is the Spire's own. plazaChance is how often a block is left an open plaza with cover. bandEvery puts a band of neon every so many storeys. bridgeFloors are the floors a skybridge crosses at between two core towers across a street. facadeTile is the metres a facade's texture covers (its windows the same size on every wall), windowGlow how bright the lit windows are, neonGlow the neon's.
_traversal: ziplines between the tallest roofs (pairs), jump towers and respawn beacons in the plazas; the launch pads stand at every other crossing.
_skyline: The city past the edge, never reached and never solid: count towers between from and to metres from the middle, the tallest tallest metres over 30. glyphs great holo shapes hang over it at glyphHeight metres and up to half as much again, in the districts' colours, so the city glows to the horizon at night (Hyper Scape's skyline had its holograms). clear is the metres every skyline tower keeps outside the edge's wall (Phase 20 A4: towers stood over the edge).
_signs: Holo signs on towers of minStoreys and more (two on the tallest), w by h metres, lit at signGlow, each a brand of ours, some of them the owner's friends'. beaconLights puts a red warning light on that many of the tallest roofs; cornerNeon is how thick the neon up a tower's corners is, metres.
_botRoofs: The bots' way onto the roofs (city.ts, brpoi.ts building route): a tower of up to maxStoreys storeys has its stairs on the graph, from outside its door to its roof, joined to the nearest street node within reach metres. A tall tower's climb is a match's worth of stairs for a bot, so only the low ones: the roofs a fight is had from. tools/checks/sk-roofs.ts walks every one with a bot's own rules.
_downtown: The dense downtown (city.ts downtownBlock), from the centre out: the blocks within `rings` of the Spire's are built as a podium of podium storeys over most of the block (its roof a terrace a storey or two up), one side kept open as a plaza strip of plazaStrip metres, and two to four towers standing on the podium, split by canyons of canyon metres (a double jump's width) so their roofs step in storeys you can climb from one to the next. Tower heights are storeys above the podium, by ring. Every block has a jump pad on its plaza strip that throws you onto the podium, and every terrace a pad up to the next tower's roof (each pad's speed worked out from the height it has to clear and the movement's own gravity, 17.5 m/s/s in SpeedKills). margin is the pavement left round the podium. Ours, after Hyper Scape's Neo Arcadia: a concrete jungle cut by streets, rooftops as the high ground, a pad on every block. Phase 21's massing (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.3): the centre is the tallest part of the map. Round the Spire (ring 1) a tower is 14 to 18 storeys over its podium, its roof 64 to 80 m; the two either side of a chimney, within twinReach metres of its line and along half its length or more, are the twins, 22 to 26 storeys, 96 to 112 m. Each draws its height from the one random number it always drew, so every tower stands where it stood and only rises.
_spire: THE SPIRE, the centre block, as tiers: a podium over the block, then `tiers`, each that many storeys tall and tierInset metres in from the one below, their roofs terraces with a pad up the east face to the next, and a mast on the top. Phase 21's heights (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.3): tier 1 to 64.2 m (the Sky Park's height), tier 2 to 96.2, tier 3 to 128.2, and the crown deck at 140.2, the mast to 180; the capture zone's 14 m round the middle takes in tier 2's terrace and everything above it. The first sharedTiers tiers draw their roof clutter from the city's one random stream, as the three tiers always did; a tier past them draws from its own, so adding one moves nothing in the blocks built after the Spire's. The hero of the skyline and the hottest drop. `drop`: the plan's drop (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.5, route 5): a shaft `size` metres square with its middle at `at` (x, z from the Spire's middle, beside the crown), open in the top tier's roof and running down through every tier to the podium, 120 m with no fall damage. At its foot a corridor `door` metres wide and a storey tall runs out through the first tier to the podium's terrace, and at the Sky Park's height another runs out through the second tier onto the Sky Park's terrace: the fast way down from the crown to the concourse, or from the Sky Park. One way: the pads up the tiers' east faces are the way back up. Lit down its corners in the chain's colour (`light`). `machinery`: the Spire's top as the plan has it (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.4, Glass's machinery): a stack of pipes `stacks.size` (x, height, z) at each corner of the top tier's terrace, `stacks.inset` from its outer corner, and a machine `machine.size` on the crown deck at `machine.at` from its middle, clear of the crown's pad's landing and the drop's mouth. Solid, the city's own boxes (cover on the capture zone's last ground), each wearing the Glass pack's piece from Balanced up.
_padSolve: A jump pad onto a roof (city.ts padOnto), in metres: it stands standOff past a body's radius from the face, throws you straight up to peakOver above the roof, and once you are clear above the edge carries you across to land landInside past it. Ours, so a pad lands you on the roof with no steering; holding forward in the air still carries you further.
_perimeter: The middle of the city (city.ts perimeterBlock), the blocks at ring `ring` from the Spire's: Hyper Scape's mid-rise blocks, buildings of depth metres deep standing wall to wall round the block's edge on a courtyard, each segment metres long, their heights storeys at random but never more than step storeys from the one beside (a storey is a climb, two a double jump and a climb, so you run and climb the roofs round the block). One side has a passage of passage metres into the courtyard. A pad on the street throws you onto the roofs, and one in the courtyard. Ours, after the screenshots of Neo Arcadia's blocks. Its buildings of at least enter.minSeg metres along the street and up to enter.maxStoreys storeys are entered (the taller are reached from their neighbours' roofs, and entering every one cost 200k triangles, measured by tools/checks/city-budget.ts), with a door on the street and one on the courtyard and stairs up every floor to the roof, the owner's ask: a player who lands with nothing climbs to the loot without a pad. Under 9 m deep a stair's treads get too shallow for the bots (brpoi.ts building).
_landmarks: A landmark per district (city.ts landmark), on the block of it nearest the Spire, each a shape of its own so every district has a face to navigate by: Hyper Scape's districts each stood round a monument, and its criticism was that the rest looked alike. The block is given by its column and row in blocks (0 to 6, the Spire at 3, 3). Each is built to be climbed, with pads up it.
_concourse: The centre as one district (city.ts, Phase 19 step 5), after Hyper Scape's Red Tiger, the dense heart at the middle of its map with its best loot: the core's podiums are all the Spire's podium height (downtown.podium), so bridges of bridge metres wide cross every street between them and the Spire's, one raised concourse over the streets. Round each podium's edge the towers stand promenade metres back, a walk to the bridges. Every podium has a public stair on its plaza side, steps no taller than stairRise (under the 0.56 m a body steps up) and stairRun deep, stairWidth wide, so its concourse is reached with no pad and no gun.
_highway: The rooftop highway (city.ts, Phase 19 step 7): a walkable deck of width metres at height metres (six storeys, among the mid-rise roofs and under the downtown's), looping the core over the street between the downtown and the mid-rise ring (street is its index in the city's streets, counted from the west or north), a fast way round the city above the fights in the streets. It stands on portal frames at the kerbs, clear of the street's middle the bots walk, at frames metres along each side; jump pads throw you up onto it from the street at pads metres along each side, and its rail is rail metres high. Ours, after Hyper Scape's elevated walks and the owner's ask for verticality.
_lampPools: The pool of light under each street lamp (city.ts), radius metres across the road at opacity: the streets lit at night, where they read as dark gaps between the towers. One instanced mesh for all of them.
_streetLife: The streets lived in (city.ts, Phase 19 step 9): parked cars in the lanes lane metres either side of a street's middle, carChance of a place for one taken on each stretch of kerb, every one cover at street level, lit white in front and red behind; a car is car metres long, wide and high, its cabin cabin. They keep padClear metres from any pad and leave the street's middle, where the bots walk, clear. Zebra crossings of stripes stripes at every junction's four sides. Canopies over the podiums' shopfronts, canopy metres deep at canopyAt metres up, solid, a ledge to stand on. Colours by eye, a night street's.
_edge: The city's edge (Phase 20 A4; src/game/edge.ts, city.ts, main.ts edgeFrame). margin: how far past the edge a body can go before a wall stops it, metres: the owner's about 40, held to 38 because the range's covered lane ends 39 to 40 m north of the city (its back wall at world z 210 to 211, measured off the range's solids in a match), which keeps a body a metre off it. countdown: the owner's 5 s outside before the laser; a step back in stops it and the next time out starts from 5 again. strike: seconds from the laser's hit to the death, the screen red meanwhile. gulag: an out-of-bounds first death goes to the Gulag as a ring death does. The laser stands laserSeconds on every screen, laserRadius metres at its core, from laserHeight up. fence: the lit fence on the four sides at the edge, height metres, a post every postGap m, opacity far and nearOpacity within nearAt m, its lines climbing scroll a second. Ours, by eye, except margin.
_chimneys: The owner's chain as geometry (docs/PHASE_21_LAYOUT.md, the four chimneys): two runnable walls width apart and length long, closed at the far end, one per side of the Spire in a canyon the city already has (x the canyon's middle, map-local, measured by tools/centre-canyons.ts; z0 to z1 its length, extended to length), standing on whatever the canyon stands on (the centre's podium roof, 8.2 m, measured off the solids as built). width 3.0 m: the zig-zag climbs 1.41 m a crossing there and holds without end up to 4.25 m (src/config/reach.json). A landing spans the gap at the far end rise above the floor, and the top at the near end twice it, for the second leg after the tap-strafe 180. rise 5.5 m, measured by tools/checks/sk-chimneys.ts in the built city: one wall run and a double jump without kicks reach 4.6 m above the floor, and the kicks reach 6.5 m and more in 27 m, so at 5.5 m only the chain lands it, and the check fails either way round. The chain line is lit in its one colour (the brief's rule 9). Phase 21's stack (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.5, the owner's chain, route 3): the chimney climbs `legs` legs of `rise`, a landing at the far end and the near end in turn, from its floor to its summit (10: 8.2 m to 63.2 m), every leg proven from standing on its landing. Where a near-end landing is `exit.below` metres under a room of a twin either side (the Sky Lobby's floor 2 m over the landing at 30.2, the Sky Park's 1 m over the one at 63.2), the chimney's wall opens onto that room's window, which the canyon's join puts there, against the room's corner wall (`exit.inset`): a mantle off the landing into the room, and from the room a way out onto the stack. The canyon's jump from window to window crosses the chimney through both openings. The wall's opening runs from the landing up past the window: with its sill at the room's floor a run crossed the canyon on it without a jump (sk-lobbies caught it), and a sill between caught a body stepping out; from the landing up there is neither, and the canyon is the jump it was.
_skyLobby: The Sky Lobby (docs/PHASE_21_LAYOUT.md, the brief's levels: storey 8, about 32 m): every downtown tower that stands above it by two storeys is open for that one storey, a floor with a window in the middle of every face, width by height, in walls wall thick, so a tower is a room you run through and a canyon is a jump from window to window. A window pad stands on the podium in front of every face with minOpen metres of open floor and nothing overhead (tools/centre-towers.ts measured 11 of 16 towers with two such faces), none within apart of another pad; its throw is solved as THE CHAIN's (src/config/chaincourse.json window: the stand-off, the push over the sill, the peak, the hold), since the window is the same size. A face's window and its pad slide along the face when the middle is taken (the block's own pad onto a roof stands in the middle of a face more often than not): slide is how far either way, a share of the face, and corner is the least wall left between a window and the tower's corner. height is 3.6 m, not the window pad's 2.8, so a sprint jump goes through: it peaks 1.42 m up (reach.json), and a 1.83 m body at its peak needs 3.25 m, with room over the head. Two lobbies across a canyon (canyon metres apart or less) have their windows lined up, a jump from one into the other; across a street (bridge metres or less) a bridge runs from window to window at the lobby's floor. `ring`: a line of light round every lobby tower at the storey's floor and its ceiling, the window pads' blue, so the level reads from anywhere (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.4). `floors`: the storeys (counted from the street) that every lobby tower also opens as a room, the lobby's four windows and no pads: 3, just over the concourse, and 7, just under the lobby, both on the tower's stair core (stairCore). The plan's floors next to each deck (docs/PHASE_21_PLAN_THE_VERTICAL_CENTRE.md 2.2), for the 10 to 30 m band that stood empty.
_skyPark: The Sky Park (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.4 and 4.5; Phase 21's levels: storey 16, about 64 m): every tower open for the Sky Lobby that stands two storeys over this storey too is open for it as well, the same room of four windows (skyLobby's width, height and wall). Rooms facing each other are joined as the lobby's are: across a canyon of up to `canyon` metres the windows line up for a sprint jump, across a street of up to `bridge` a bridge runs window to window. The Spire's first tier ends at this height, so its roof is the Sky Park's terrace, and every room facing it across a street gets a bridge onto it, its parapet opened `gap` metres where the bridge lands and the line kept `landing` metres in from the terrace's corners. No window pads: a 56 m throw is the Spire's own pad, and the way up is the tiers' pads, the roofs at this height and, next, the chimney stacks. `ring`: its line of light round every tower at its storey, the bridges' gold. `floors`: the storeys a tower open for the Sky Park also opens as rooms between the lobby and it, 9 (just over the lobby), 12 and 15 (just under the Sky Park), all on the tower's stair core, which runs through them to the Sky Park: the 30 to 60 m band the plan asks 20,000 m2 of.
_stairCore: A stair up through every lobby tower (the plan's 2.3: every deck by stairs inside a tower, no pad and no ability): a core of two lanes `lane` wide, a flight of `rise` and `run` steps a storey in each lane in turn, switching back at a landing `landing` deep at either end, from a door `door` wide in the tower's end face on the concourse's promenade up through the open floors to the Sky Lobby, and on to the Sky Park in a tower tall for it. Cut out of the tower, so nothing else moves; a tower whose two end faces both stand over a canyon has none.
_metro: The metro (the owner's, 2026-09-27: under the street, only the centre, a decent size; docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md section 9): a loop of tunnel under the centre's four streets (`streets`, their indices in the city's streets from the west or north: the two either side of the Spire's block, so the loop runs under x and z of -36 and 36), `width` metres wide, its floor `floor` metres under the street and the street over it a slab `slab` thick, so a tunnel `floor` less `slab` tall: 5 m, room for a double jump. Walls `wall` thick close it in. Stairs go down from each street's outer lane (`lane` metres from its middle, a parked car's lane, never the bots' way down the middle), their middles `stairs` metres along it from the side's middle, `stairWidth` wide and the concourse's rise and run, the opening railed `rail` high on its sides and the far end. A parked train of `train.cars` cars, each `train.length` by `train.width` by `train.height`, stands on each side's inner lane as cover, too tall to stand on under the roof. Lights in the ceiling every `lightEvery` metres. Ours: 288 m of tunnel, the fast covered way round the Spire, and the only place in the city under the street.
_neonAlley: Neon Alley (docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md 4.3.1, the plan's showpiece street): the street `street` (its index in the city's streets from the north: the one in front of the Spire's north face, z -36) from `from` to `to` along it, the Spire's block. Its stalls are the city's, solid cover on the Spire's pavement, each `stall` metres (along the street, deep, tall) with its middle at each of `stalls` along the street, set `back` metres in from the block's edge; the bought kit dresses each as a food stand, and a copy without it shows a dark kiosk. Everything else the alley wears is the kit's (citykit.json dress alley).
_fireEscape: Fire escapes up the street faces of High City's and Kyber's towers (the families in citykit.json dress families), after the plan (docs/PHASE_21_PLAN_THE_VERTICAL_CENTRE.md: ladders you can fight on; docs/CITY_BUNDLE_IMPLEMENTATION.md rule 7). Their shape is the bought pieces' (citykit.json dress escapes, measured). From the promenade a drop ladder climbs to the first landing, a storey up, which you walk under; a flight of `treads` steps (each 0.5 m, under the 0.56 m a body steps up, and `tread` thick) climbs from each landing to the next, in the outer lane, through a hole in the landing over it, and the inner strip, `gap` short of the stair, is the way back to the next flight's foot; from the top landing, a storey under the roof, you climb the wall to the roof. A rail `rail` high and `railThick` thick round each landing, open over the ladder. Each stands `corner` metres from its face's corner, on a face with no canyon in front, the promenade under it, nothing solid in its way, no pad within clear.pad metres, no window of an open storey within clear.window and no door within clear.door; one a tower at most (`perTower`), on towers of `minStoreys` and more. Drawn in the city's boxes, which the kit hides once it dresses them. Where a landing stands at an open storey's floor (the Sky Lobby, the Sky Park and their open floors), a doorway `door` metres wide and the storey's window high through that room's wall, in the middle of the landing, onto its inner strip (Phase 22.3); only where the room is clear `doorClear` metres in behind it (a stair core may stand there).
_steam: Steam over the centre (steam.ts; Phase 22.2), looks only: warm air up out of the metro's stairwells, off drains at the kerbs (every `drainEvery` metres down each street, at `drainChance`, `drainOut` metres from its middle) and off the plant on some roofs (`ventChance` of the centre's towers, their first roof box). Each source is `perSource` puffs of soft light, each living `life` seconds as it rises `rise` metres, grows from size[0] to size[1] across, and drifts on the `wind` (m/s, x and z) with a `wobble`; brightest at `peak` of `color` halfway up. Added light, never paint, so it can brighten a view but never hide a body in it. Nowhere within `clear` metres of a pad, and never more than `cap` puffs. From Balanced up; Competitive has none, where seeing is the game.
_flicker: A few of the centre's lit signs flicker (steam.ts cityFlicker; Phase 22.2): `signs` of the holo signs on its towers, chosen by where they stand, each in a material of its own. Time runs in windows of `window` seconds; in each, at `chance`, a burst of burst[0] to burst[1] dips, `spacing` seconds apart, each dipLength[0] to dipLength[1] long, down to dip[0] to dip[1] of the sign's light. Dips are never closer than `spacing`, so no sign flashes more than three times a second (the photosensitive line, WCAG 2.3.1), and a burst ends at least that long before the next window's. From Balanced up.
